messages:
Sam: Kickoff: proposing a rolling micro-canary approach for model v6 focused on minimizing cold-starts and honoring tenant-level opt-outs. Want concrete slices, pre-checks, and explicit fail/fallback semantics.

Iris: 👍 Outline please, include how Dedicated orgs are handled and any billing/SLA implications.

Sam: Plan summary:
- Shadow 8h global, collect perf + hallucination heuristics
- Stage A: 0.25% tenants in a low-traffic zone (single region) for 2h
- Stage B: 2% in two regions for 6h with overlapping windows (start every 50% window)
- Stage C: 10% spread with A/B control for 12h
- Ramp: +10% every 3h if gates pass
Tenant opt-in via feature flag; Dedicated orgs default OFF and can set `org_override=true` after account-ops approval.

DevOps-Rahul: Pre-slice checks: ensure no tenant in slice has active blackout windows or region constraints. Run priming: `scripts/prime.sh --tenant T --model v6 --samples 300` 10m before slice. Propagate routing denylist within 20s.

SRE-Oliver: Auto-kill triggers:
- p99 gen latency > 220ms sustained 5m
- 5xx > 0.7% over 5m
- token-cost delta > +30% over 10m
- hallucination-rate spike > baseline + 3 sigma
Circuit breakers: per-node queue > 160 for 3m or GPU mem > 88% for 2m -> throttle and fallback. Sticky fallback 300s. If tenant hits >3 fallbacks in 30m -> block for 24h and page.

Iris: A/B measurement: `ab-runner --control v5 --variant v6 --min-sample 2500 --metrics latency,cost,hallucination_rate`. Require 95% data completeness before decision.

Sam: Flag payload we expect ops to accept (example string in playbook): `{flag: "v6_rollout", scope: "tenant", tenants: ["t-prod"], pct: 0.25, regions: ["us-west"], org_override: false, region_constraint: null, requires_kms: false}`

DevOps-Rahul: Will add API to accept that schema and ledger entries for priming + flag changes. Flag-bot: promoting feature-flag-service v4.2 to staging now.

flag-bot: deploy: feature-flag-service v4.2 to staging at 2026-07-10T13:02Z :white_check_mark:

SRE-Oliver: Dashboards: per-tenant heatmap for p95/p99, token-cost, fallback-count, and hallucination alerts. Add routing-consistency probe every 60s. Alert policy: correlated spike across latency+cost+fallback -> P1.

Iris: Legal note: if tenant requires data residency/KMS, routing must honor `region_constraint` and reject slices that would violate. Ops to provide capacity impact estimate for such constraints.

Sam: Owners: product=Sam, eng=Iris, ops=DevOps-Rahul, oncall=SRE-Oliver. Next: Rahul adds pre-slice validator + priming API, Oliver stubs alerts + runbook, Iris wires A/B configs. I'll schedule a 30m signoff shiproom once PRs are linked.

Iris: Adding one more: include a rollout metric `excluded_tenants_pct` so we can see how many were skipped due to blackout/constraints.

Sam: Good call. Invite incoming. :calendar:
